Name: Requiring the reapplication of food protection course certification every 5 years.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the reapplication of food protection course certification every 5 years

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Health
This Introduction was Hearing Held by Committee
This Introduction was Laid Over by Committee

Summary: This bill would require any person who is charged with managing or supervising the operation of a food service establishment to obtain a food protection course certificate every 5 years.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring the reapplication of food protection course certification every 5 years

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Section 17-1501 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new definition of “food protection course certification” in alphabetical order to read as follows:
Food protection course certification. The term “food protection course certification” means a certificate or certification, issued by the department upon (i) a person’s completion of a course of instruction covering food protection principles, including safe food handling and storage, time and temperature control for safety, prevention of cross-contamination, personal hygiene practices, allergen awareness, and sanitation of food-contact surfaces and equipment, and any additional information the department deems relevant, as provided in section 21-02 of title 24 of the rules of the city of New York, regarding food protection courses and fees, or a successor provision; and in accordance with section 81.15 of the New York city health code regarding food protection courses, or a successor provision; and (ii) passage of a written examination administered by or on behalf of the department demonstrating competency in such principles, as provided in section 21-02 of title 24 of the rules of the city of New York, regarding food protection courses and fees, or a successor provision; and in accordance with section 81.15 of the New York city health code regarding food protection courses, or a successor provision.
§ 2. Subdivision a of Section 17-1509 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by local law number 80 for the year 2021, is amended to read as follows: 
a. A person who is charged with the management or supervision of the operations of a food service establishment shall [comply with the requirements set forth in subdivision (a) of section 81.15 of the health code of the city of New York regarding a food protection course and certification.] obtain a food protection course certification. Such certification shall be valid for 5 years from the date of issuance. A person holding such certification shall reapply for and obtain a new certification no less frequently than once every 5 years. 
§ 3. This local law takes effect 120 days after it becomes law.
